# Beacon 1.0.5
- Added a dedicated Subscriptions workspace with full record editing, payment history, and revenue-share reporting. - Added person-scoped subscription access for Developer users while keeping unrelated subscriptions hidden. - Added interactive dashboard and finance-report drill-downs, sortable report tables, and direct links to related records. - Standardized time-log reporting across company and dashboard views, including daily resource-grouped detail. - Improved live dashboard/report refresh behavior and removed obsolete manual refresh and Quickbase-authority messaging.

## What’s new
- Makes finance navigation much faster by keeping live data subscriptions warm and reducing unnecessary whole-window redraws. - Keeps invoices, payments, payables, dashboards, companies, projects, contacts, and reports updated live when Beacon or QuickBooks data changes. - Automatically creates referral payables when qualifying client invoices are paid, with chronological Beacon payable numbers and clearer source details. - Creates QuickBooks bills through the shared Beacon connection, opens QuickBooks to unpaid bills, and improves bill status and error handling. - Simplifies the Payables workflow and standardizes payable and invoice-line tables with the rest of the app. - Includes the latest company, project, contact, user-permission, related-time-log, and QuickBooks customer-linking improvements. - Fixes an activity-update feedback loop and reduces unnecessary background work.
After updating, Beacon will keep finance screens current automatically as shared data changes.

## What’s new
- Fixes daily analysis drafts that contain a malformed client or project ID when the displayed client and project names uniquely identify the correct Beacon records. - Shows a warning whenever Beacon safely corrects those IDs before presenting the recommendation. - Continues to reject ambiguous matches or IDs that point to a different real record.
After updating, choose **Analyze day** again for any day that previously showed the catalog-validation error.

## What’s new
- Adds signed automatic updates, so Beacon only needs to be installed manually once. - Adds the finance-only AP/AR workspace with access to Cash Flow and Reports. - Applies role-based navigation and permissions for owner and AP/AR accounts. - Includes the latest company, contact, project, time-log, and QuickBooks workflow improvements.
Beacon checks for updates every six hours and installs downloaded updates after the app quits.
